newsitem.title: GREECE: EUROBANK, INTERBANK LOWER LENDING, DEPO RATES.
newsitem.headline: EUROBANK, INTERBANK LOWER LENDING, DEPO RATES.

text.p: Eurobank and Interbank said on Tuesday they are lowering their rates for business, consumer and housing loans as well as their savings deposit rates.
The base lending rate for business loans will be cut to 17 percent. Consumer loan rates will also drop with auto loan rates down to 18.7 and consumer loans at 22.0 percent.

The base rate for housing loans will fall to 15.5 percent while all savings deposits rates will come down 50 basis points ranging from 10.0 to 11.2 percent. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
